description: Two pole lowpass filter on the Sallen-Key topology, with the saturation of the feedback path modelled, so the resonant peak compresses and dirties instead of ringing cleanly

params.text: Sets the cutoff frequency, with an exponential response that spreads the travel evenly over the audible range
Emphasises the frequencies around the cutoff, and at high settings the filter self-oscillates
Sets the level of the signal entering the filter, and because the saturation happens inside the feedback loop, low settings give a clean filter and high settings a saturated, compressed tone
Attenuates and inverts the CV1 input before it is added to the cutoff
Attenuates and inverts the CV2 input before it is added to the cutoff

inputs.text: A control voltage added to the cutoff, scaled by the CV1 attenuverter
A control voltage added to the cutoff, scaled by the CV2 attenuverter
The audio input to the filter

outputs.text: The filtered signal, with DC blocked
